reply: {"action":"run_code","code":"type IssuePage = { items: { milestone: { title: string } | null }[]; next_page: number | null }; const counts = new Map<string, number>(); let page: number | null = 1; while (page) { const result = await tools.list_issues({ repo: 'acme/api', state: 'open', page }) as IssuePage; for (const { milestone } of result.items) { if (milestone) counts.set(milestone.title, (counts.get(milestone.title) ?? 0) + 1); } page = result.next_page; } return [...counts].sort(([titleA, countA], [titleB, countB]) => countB - countA || titleA.localeCompare(titleB));","answer":""}
